items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: he was in a movie with Fred MacMurray and Ozzie Nelson

ctx.x: Well, Omar's Dome was across the street where they now have these little theatres or something, but that's where it was -- it was Omar's Dome, it was a beautiful club, and I don't know how long we worked there, but we broadcasted there, 3 or 4 times a week, you know, and again, I was singing "My Reverie" and all the love songs, all the ballads -- I did all the ballads with him, and after that, I think that should take us up to, let's see, did I miss anything?

Oh, yes I did. I left a big space out there. I was wondering what I was doing in '38 and '39 -- now I remember other things I was doing. Okay, my first studio job, okay -- my very first studio job was ... gee, it was at the Paramount. Paramount Studios called me, they had a young boy named Billy Lee, and he was in a movie with Fred MacMurray and Ozzie Nelson, his wife, her name was Harriet ...
